### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

JetStream allows authorized users to request a stream snapshot and specify the subject used to deliver it.

### Problem Description

Snapshot requests accepted delivery subjects that the snapshot notification mechanism could not use. Such requests could leave background work and associated resources unreleased. Repeated requests could exhaust process resources; some streams could also remain unable to produce further snapshots until the server restarted.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-5xw9-67vx-qppr>
 * Credit: Taeyoung Jeong (@ttzero25)
repo.summary: Invalid snapshot delivery subjects can leak server resources
